Here in Kigoma we depend on the rains, and buying fertilizer or improved seeds from town costs too much for my pocket. I will plant the local maize variety that has done well for my family before, working the plot with our hand hoes as we always do. My family will put in the sweat for planting, weeding, and harvest, and I will hire a few extra workers from the village when the weeds are thick and during harvest time.
